title: Add helper to filter tasks by assignee
body: Adds filter_by_assignee helper to tasks/filters.py to assist assignee filtering.
author: alex_dev
diff:
diff --git a/tasks/filters.py b/tasks/filters.py
--- a/tasks/filters.py
+++ b/tasks/filters.py
@@ -11,2 +11,7 @@
     return [t for t in tasks if t.assignee_id is None]
+
+def filter_by_assignee(tasks: Iterable[Task], assignee_id: int) -> List[Task]:
+    """Returns tasks assigned to a specific user id."""
+    return [t for t in tasks if t.assignee_id == assignee_id]

title: Uppercase status badge in task summary formatter
body: Ensures the status badge in format_task_summary is always uppercase.
author: priya_n
diff:
diff --git a/utils/formatters.py b/utils/formatters.py
--- a/utils/formatters.py
+++ b/utils/formatters.py
@@ -9,3 +9,4 @@
     title = task_data.get("title", "Untitled")
-    status = task_data.get("status", "unknown").upper()
+    raw_status = task_data.get("status", "unknown")
+    status = str(raw_status).upper()
     return f"[{status}] #{task_id} - {title}"

title: Add helper to extract domain from email
body: Provides an extract_email_domain utility function in utils/validators.py.
author: elena_r
diff:
diff --git a/utils/validators.py b/utils/validators.py
--- a/utils/validators.py
+++ b/utils/validators.py
@@ -11,2 +11,7 @@
     return bool(EMAIL_REGEX.match(email.strip()))
+
+def extract_email_domain(email: str) -> str:
+    """Extracts the domain portion of an email address."""
+    return email.split("@")[-1].lower() if "@" in email else ""
